body:
Adds `research/shapley-sampling` (stdlib Python, 9 tests, experiments, white paper), a README entry and a portfolio page section.

Findings: permutation sampling is exactly efficient but noisy; size-stratified sampling has 6–8× lower variance (zero for equal contributors) at up to 7% budget error; antithetic reversal gives 1.6× lower RMSE; Hoeffding counts are 4–5× conservative.
